title: Implement FT-006 Plant history projection service and authority checks
verify: Projection tests prove PlantHistoryCard and PlantHistoryEntry values are computed from PostgreSQL/read-model source rows, not timeline replay, photo manifests, UI Feed, or agent text.

Authorization tests prove active normal read and archived retained-history read behavior for Boss, granted Engineer, granted Consultant, revoked grant, disabled membership, unauthorized Plant, and wrong Farm.
Retention tests archive a Plant with check-in, measurement, accepted photo, and admin audit rows and prove retained history remains readable only through retained-history authorization.
Timeline consistency tests prove orphan timeline events do not create history entries and missing timeline lines do not overwrite PostgreSQL source rows.
Behavior specs FT-006-BHV-001 through FT-006-BHV-003 have direct executable traceability in focused tests.
evidence_required: FT-006 projection service focused test output
redaction evidence for history summaries and refs
constraints: Use existing authoritative PostgreSQL source rows; do not create a second mutable Plant history source of truth.

Implement only Plant history projection and retained-history service behavior; do not implement Plant operations writes, photo upload, raw export packages, PWA UI, agents, Safety Gate, tasks, Companion, or dataset behavior.
Archived retained-history reads must not grant operate, task creation, action approval, agent publication, or governance transition authority.
Timeline refs are audit/export refs only and cannot create, update, sort, repair, or confirm Plant history entries.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model remains the authority for Plant card/history projection.
timeline.jsonl remains append-only audit/export and is never replayed as runtime state.
History summaries and refs must omit auth material, absolute paths, raw SQL, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, and unapproved governance content.
Future task, approval, agent, governance, and dataset source families are not faked before their owning schemas exist.
verification_targets: Inject orphan timeline events and missing timeline refs and prove PostgreSQL/read-model rows remain authoritative.
Trace FT-006-BHV-001 through FT-006-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests.
purpose: Create the backend Plant history projection boundary over authoritative runtime rows, with retained-history authorization and timeline replay safeguards before HTTP exposure.
success_outcome: FT-006 Plant card/history service reads check-in, measurement, photo, and admin audit source rows from PostgreSQL, returns safe refs, and keeps archived retained history readable without making timeline or UI presentation runtime authority.
anti_goals: No new persistent history table or event-sourcing framework.
No Plant operations write, photo upload, raw timeline export package, PWA UI, agent, Safety Gate, task, Companion, or dataset implementation.
No fake future history entries for source families whose schemas do not exist.
No feature lifecycle overclaim beyond FT-006 backend projection service.

forbidden_scope: new persistent history table or event-sourcing framework
Plant operations write, photo upload, raw timeline export package, PWA UI, agent, Safety Gate, task, Companion, or dataset behavior
fake future history entries for unimplemented source families
stop_conditions: TASK-021-T3-FT-005-W1 is not done or its photo catalog/source row contract is contradicted.
The service cannot enforce active normal read and archived retained-history read through ActorContext.
Projection would require reading timeline, manifests, UI Feed, or agent text as current authority.
A new timeline event type or source family is needed but no canonical owning spec exists.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, auth material, absolute local paths, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content.
